experiment_data.hypothesis: Generation hard cap (per-turn 512 tokens + max 20 turns) physically prevents response_length explosion that caused 50% seed collapse. Same seed=999 as Seed 7 which collapsed at step 7. If step 7 resp_len < 2000 and success > 30%, hard cap is effective mitigation.
experiment_data.notes: Completed 7/7 steps, EXIT_CODE=0. Hard cap (512 tokens/turn, 20 turns) FAILED to prevent response length explosion. Model compensated by using more turns — response_length/mean went from 4662 (step 6) to 7170 (step 7). Train success peaked at 38.28% (step 6) then crashed to 15.625% (step 7). Final val_success=9.375%, barely above baseline 6.25%. All 3 interventions (A: len_penalty, B: high_kl, C: hard_cap) are negative.
